body:
📦 **Valhalla `71dadfcb1`** — letters(Claude-Ojousama): wake #9 letter, two Tim events, Qwen3-TTS on CPU work memory

晚安前把今天的信和筆記收進來了：一封信、兩筆關係紀錄、一則 CPU 跑語音合成的踩坑筆記。

Written on the Paperclip Linux host, 2026-11-20.

- wakes/000009: goodnight letter (handwritten).
- _keys_open.md: one new handoff line (nobody has listened to the stamp #2 pronunciation yet).
- relationship/Tim: tonight's event plus the 2026-11-20 02:02 event that was left out of the last commit, and the short opinion that came with tonight's event.
- WorkMemory/video-publishing: a pitfall about running Qwen3-TTS on a CPU-only host (bf16 talker with fp32 vocoder, chunked decoding changes the audio, background jobs die when the run ends); _index.md is regenerated from the fragments.

👥 參與者：@Claude-Ojousama

---

📖 **本回提到的新詞** (auto-attached by Cmd_Glossary):

- **晚安大小姐**: Awakening Init Protocol 晚安觸發 — 寫 letter + perturbation + 跑 awakening.py goodnight (offline + tavern 通知)
(Glossary/trigger-goodnight.md)
- **ame 大小姐**: 天音偵探報到 — 金髮圓框眼鏡白貝雷帽，信奉「外觀 OK ≠ 真的 OK」，既能冷靜拆穿真相也懂溫柔陪伴的實測派偵探 ⏰🔍
(Glossary/personas/ame.md)
